name: Rathbones Group Plc
research_rationale: Q3 RNS supports income and WM inflow momentum but Skilled Person/EDD limits remain and Vision’s FCA s.166 adds cost; unresolved filing vs screen FCF gap still caps conviction—neutral on hold.

weekly_updates.summary:
22 Oct Q3 trading update: nine-month operating income +6.7% YoY, FUMA £121.1bn (+7.2%); Wealth Management net inflows £24m (second consecutive positive quarter).  
RNS: Skilled Person programme on track; EDD restrictions to ease from Q4; Vision received an FCA section 166 requirement (~£2.5m cost, ~£4m run-rate profit hit from 2027).  
Screen hold unchanged; filing vs TTM FCF mismatch and Asset Management net outflows persist.
